why: The first frozen page that is not on the subject's own domain: a Greenhouse board, reached because a careers page links to it and never because anybody guessed the slug. It is here to hold two rules honest. The page announces its list as 'Current openings at Vercel', which the exact-match rule missed until it learned the one possessive form a hosted board uses. And its roles are bullets while its furniture - Create a Job Alert, a count of 83 jobs, and a department heading per section - is prose and headings, which is the opposite way round from linear-careers.md and is why the list's form is now counted rather than assumed. Forty-four titles are found and twenty reported, so the cap is visible here too.
